verified_key_information_units.information: Gigasun's installed solar capacity increased to 395.8 MW from 340.1 MW, representing a 16% year-over-year growth and expanding its portfolio to 216 electricity-generating installations.

candidate_sentences.text: Operationally, Gigasun expanded its installed revenue-generating capacity by 15.7 MW during the year to reach 395.8 MW across 216 installations, up from 340.1 MW and 200 installations at the end of 2024.

verified_key_information_units.information: Gigasun reported revenue of SEK 239.7 million (up 9.8% YoY) and operating profit of SEK 73.5 million (up 21.1% YoY). Net profit was SEK -7.2 million, impacted by a SEK 3.8 million currency effect and SEK 3.5 million one-off cost; excluding these items, adjusted net profit was SEK 0.1 million. The full-year profit increase was significantly driven by a record Q3 with production up 36% and profit up 275% compared to Q3 2024.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Revenues amounted to SEK 239.7 (218.3) million... Operating profit amounted to SEK 73.5 (60.7) million... Profit after tax amounted to SEK -7.2 (-32.9) million and were impacted by a non-cash currency effect of SEK -3.8 (1.8) million as well as a one-off cost of SEK 3.5 million... The most notable development during the year was our record quarter in Q3. Production increased by 36 percent and profit rose by as much as 275 percent compared with the same period the previous year.

candidate_sentences.text: Total revenue for the group rose by 9.8 percent to SEK 239,655 thousand compared to SEK 218,264 thousand in the previous year, while net revenue increased by 9.9 percent to SEK 203,179 thousand from SEK 184,795 thousand.

Operating profit rose by 21.1 percent to SEK 73,478 thousand compared to SEK 60,677 thousand, reflecting improved underlying profitability from stable operations despite higher operating expenses of SEK 166,177 thousand, which were driven by increased scheduled depreciation and maintenance costs associated with a larger asset base.
Profit after tax improved significantly to SEK -7,206 thousand compared to SEK -32,944 thousand in 2024.

When adjusted for a non-cash currency effect of SEK -3,843 thousand and a one-off cost of SEK 3,500 thousand, adjusted profit stood at SEK 100 thousand, demonstrating core operational profitability compared to SEK -34,700 thousand previously.
